record: The real herd, the herder and a sale at the pens, in a browser (sim/stock.mjs, public/herd-view.js)
note: Same computer only, headless Chrome at 1366x768. One real class through the join flow on the invented country (seed herds-proof). No LAN or district claim.
checks: the family's herd of 9 cattle and 14 hogs is drawn on its land as 23 figures, 6 of them young (clips cattle-longhorn-dun-idle, cattle-longhorn-pied-graze, cow-walk, cattle-longhorn-pied-idle, cattle-longhorn-red-graze, hog-root, pig-walk, hog-idle)
Silas (a hand of 3) is out after the stock on the family's horse; the herd is drawn about them and the horn on the row is lit ("The best hand with stock on this land. Out after the herd now.")
hovering the herd says "9 cattle, fair · 14 hogs, fair · 2 calves · 4 pigs · minded now by Silas, the best hand with stock"
the record says: "Silas Proofwright rode the range and counted the stock: 9 cattle and 14 hogs, the cattle fair, the hogs fair. The calves are marked, and nothing will stray for a month."
"Hannah Proofwright sold 2 cattle, fair, to Anselmo Treviño at the stock pens for 8 reales." - the family has 7 cattle and 11 reales
the herd drawn on the land is the herd less the two sold (7 cattle)
a herd of 60 cattle and 140 hogs is drawn as 24 figures, with groups of 54 cattle and 124 hogs
